description: Molecular Adverse Outcome Pathway for [AOP 48](https://identifiers.org/aop/48), "Binding of agonists to ionotropic glutamate receptors in adult brain causes excitotoxicity that mediates neuronal cell death, contributing to learning and memory impairment.". Key Event nodes and the relationships between them are from AOP-Wiki RDF 97191db (2026-08-01); the green pathway nodes are the molecular pathways mapped to each Key Event and approved in the molAOP Builder (snapshot 2026-08-13).
title: Ionotropic glutamate receptor agonism causing excitotoxicity and impaired learning and memory
